lines.text: 精英敌人有概率掉落额外的好东西

texts.en: Elite foes have a chance to drop something extra.

lines.text: 越往里走，我摆出来的货越好，嘿嘿

texts.en: The deeper you go, the finer the wares I lay out. Heh.

lines.text: 东西卖给我就好，我肯定出个公道价格，嘿嘿

texts.en: Sell it to me, friend. I always give a fair price. Heh.
The longer you linger, the harder it is to leave.

lines.text: 拿不动的先托付给出口那儿接应的人，他们比你先到家

texts.en: Hand what you can't carry to the crew waiting at the exit. They'll be home before you.

lines.text: 别太贪心，拿的东西越多，就越走不动路

texts.en: Don't be greedy. The more you carry, the slower you walk.

lines.text: 哟，来客人了。慢慢看，都是好东西，嘿嘿

texts.en: Well, a customer. Take your time, it's all good stuff. Heh.

lines.text: 又是你？活着就好，活着才能照顾我生意

texts.en: You again? Good, you're alive. The living make better customers.

lines.text: 这种地方还能碰上活人，真是缘分。看看货？

texts.en: A living soul in a place like this. Must be fate. Care to browse?

lines.text: 别光站着，看上什么尽管拿，价钱好商量

texts.en: Don't just stand there. Take what you fancy, the price can be talked over.

lines.text: 朋友，你来得正好，我刚把摊子摆好

texts.en: Friend, perfect timing. I've only just laid out the stall.
